items.followUp: State one difference between arteries and veins in the thickness of their walls.

rubric.why: An artery is defined by the direction in which it carries blood.
rubric.description: Defines arteries as blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that arteries carry blood away from the heart.

rubric.why: A vein is defined by the direction in which it carries blood.
rubric.description: Defines veins as blood vessels that carry blood towards the heart.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that veins carry blood towards the heart.

modelAnswer: Arteries are blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.
Veins are blood vessels that carry blood towards the heart.

items.followUp: Name the three main divisions of biology and state what each one studies.

rubric.why: A definition of biology is required before its divisions are explained.
rubric.description: Defines biology as the study of life.
rubric.how: Award 2 marks for defining biology as the study of life.

rubric.why: Botany is one of the three main divisions of biology.
rubric.description: Identifies botany as the study of plants.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for botany and plants.

rubric.why: Zoology is one of the three main divisions of biology.
rubric.description: Identifies zoology as the study of animals.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for zoology and animals.

rubric.why: Microbiology is one of the three main divisions of biology.
rubric.description: Identifies microbiology as the study of microorganisms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for microbiology and microorganisms.

modelAnswer: Biology is the study of life.
Botany is the study of plants.
Zoology is the study of animals.
Microbiology is the study of microorganisms.

items.followUp: Describe the structure and one function of mitochondria and ribosomes.

rubric.why: The Golgi apparatus is characterized by its stack of membrane-bound flattened sacs.
rubric.description: Describes the Golgi apparatus as a stack of flattened membrane sacs.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the Golgi apparatus structure.

rubric.why: The Golgi apparatus modifies and packages substances for transport or secretion.
rubric.description: States a function of the Golgi apparatus, such as modifying or packaging proteins.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct Golgi apparatus function.

rubric.why: Lysosomes contain enzymes that digest materials in the cell.
rubric.description: States that lysosomes contain digestive enzymes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for lysosome contents or intracellular digestion.

rubric.why: Lysosomes digest cellular materials, including worn-out organelles.
rubric.description: Gives a lysosome function, such as digesting worn-out organelles or being called suicidal bags.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct lysosome function.

modelAnswer: The Golgi apparatus consists of stacks of flattened membrane sacs.
It modifies, sorts and packages proteins into vesicles for transport or secretion.
Lysosomes are membrane-bound sacs containing digestive enzymes.
They digest materials and worn-out cell organelles, so they are sometimes called suicidal bags.

items.followUp: Name two endangered species found in Pakistan and state one threat faced by each.

rubric.why: The answer must explain what makes a species endangered.
rubric.description: Defines endangered species as species at risk of extinction, often because their populations have declined.
rubric.how: Award 2 marks for a clear definition involving risk of extinction.

rubric.why: The Indus river dolphin is an endangered species found in Pakistan.
rubric.description: Names the Indus river dolphin and identifies its Indus river habitat or characteristic blindness.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a relevant fact about the Indus river dolphin.

rubric.why: The snow leopard is an endangered species found in Pakistan's northern mountain regions.
rubric.description: Names the snow leopard and gives its mountain habitat or a relevant fact.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a relevant fact about the snow leopard.

rubric.why: The markhor is a threatened wild goat species found in Pakistan's mountainous regions.
rubric.description: Names the markhor and gives its mountainous habitat or a relevant fact.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a relevant fact about the markhor.

modelAnswer: Endangered species are species whose populations have become so small that they are at risk of extinction.
The Indus river dolphin is an endangered freshwater dolphin found in the Indus River; dams and reduced river flow threaten it.
The snow leopard lives in the high mountains of northern Pakistan and is threatened by habitat loss and hunting.
The markhor is a wild goat of Pakistan's mountainous regions; habitat loss and illegal hunting threaten its population.

items.followUp: Write the word equations for aerobic respiration and alcoholic fermentation.

rubric.why: Aerobic respiration requires oxygen and releases energy from glucose.
rubric.description: Explains that aerobic respiration occurs in the presence of oxygen and breaks down glucose to release energy.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the role of oxygen and glucose in aerobic respiration.

rubric.why: These are the products of aerobic respiration.
rubric.description: Gives carbon dioxide and water as products of aerobic respiration.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct aerobic respiration products.

rubric.why: Anaerobic respiration takes place without oxygen.
rubric.description: Explains that anaerobic respiration occurs in the absence of oxygen.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that oxygen is not used.

rubric.why: Anaerobic respiration yields less energy and forms lactic acid in muscles or ethanol and carbon dioxide in yeast.
rubric.description: Names an anaerobic product and indicates its lower energy yield.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct anaerobic product or lower energy yield.

modelAnswer: Aerobic respiration is the breakdown of glucose in the presence of oxygen to release energy.
Glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy.
Anaerobic respiration is the breakdown of glucose without oxygen and releases less energy.
In muscles, glucose → lactic acid + energy; in yeast, glucose → ethanol + carbon dioxide + energy.

items.followUp: Name the main proteins in blood plasma and give one function of plasma.

rubric.why: Plasma is the liquid component of blood and has a characteristic pale yellow appearance.
rubric.description: Describes plasma as the straw-coloured liquid part of blood.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the appearance and liquid nature of plasma.

rubric.why: Water forms the major part of plasma.
rubric.description: States that plasma is mainly water, approximately 90%.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for its water content.

rubric.why: The principal plasma proteins include albumin, globulins and fibrinogen.
rubric.description: Names the main plasma proteins.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the plasma proteins.

rubric.why: Plasma transports dissolved substances and also contributes to clotting and defence.
rubric.description: Gives a correct function of plasma, such as transport, clotting or defence.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one correct plasma function.

modelAnswer: Blood plasma is the straw-coloured liquid component of blood and makes up about 55% of its volume.
It consists mainly of water (about 90%), with dissolved substances including nutrients, salts, hormones and waste products.
Its main proteins are albumin, globulins and fibrinogen.
Plasma transports dissolved substances; fibrinogen helps blood clot, while antibodies in plasma help defend the body.

items.followUp: What is horticulture? Give one example of a product obtained through it.

rubric.why: Horticulture involves cultivating useful and ornamental plants.
rubric.description: Identifies horticulture as the cultivation of plants, especially fruits, vegetables and flowers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct meaning of horticulture.

rubric.why: Horticulture benefits people through food, ornamental plants or economic value.
rubric.description: States a valid use or benefit of horticulture to humans.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one relevant benefit.

modelAnswer: Horticulture is the cultivation of fruits, vegetables, flowers and other garden plants.
It provides food and ornamental plants and can also provide income and employment.

items.followUp: What is the tissue level of biological organization?

rubric.why: An organ system consists of several organs working together.
rubric.description: Defines the organ system level as a group of organs working together.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that multiple organs act together.

rubric.why: The organs in a system cooperate to perform a particular function.
rubric.description: States that the system performs a particular function, or gives a suitable example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the function or a correct example.

modelAnswer: The organ system level is the level at which different organs work together to perform a major body function.
For example, the organs of the digestive system work together to digest food and absorb nutrients.
